title: Packed full colour HEVC — experimental

headset_settings.render_resolution: Keep current headset resolution and foveation

notice: Experimental full-colour transport. Requires matching server and Quest Pro client builds. Use HEVC, 8-bit and initially 72 Hz. Decoder workload is higher; sustained stereo operation and latency are not yet qualified. Save and restart WiVRn between tests to apply.
notes: Preserves full-resolution chroma sample locations using hardware 4:2:0 video decoding and GPU unpacking.
Does not change headset bit rate or refresh rate automatically.
Selecting an ordinary encoder preset clears this experimental layout.
